what_to_make: Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello, and welcome! Today you're going to say hello in French. It's the very first thing you'll ever say to a French friend, so let's make it a good one. First you'll hear a tiny conversation. Then you'll say the lines yourself. Ready? Let's go!
Teacher explains: In French, 'hello' is bonjour. 'Hi' is salut, and it's what you say to friends. 'Goodbye' is au revoir. Say them after me.
Teacher says: Bonjour !
Child voice says (model): Bonjour !
Teacher says: Salut !
Child voice says (model): Salut !
Child voice says (model): Bonjour !
Teacher says: Salut !
Teacher says: Au revoir !
Child voice says (model): Au revoir !
Teacher prompt: Tu rencontres un ami au parc.
Teacher recap: Today you learned three things: bonjour, salut, and au revoir. You said hello and goodbye like a real French speaker.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Welcome back! Last time you said hello. Today, your friend wants to know your name. We'll keep our hellos, and add one new sentence: 'My name is'. You'll say your own name at the end, so get ready!
Teacher explains: To say your name, you say je m'appelle, then your name. And to ask back, you say et toi, which means 'and you?'.
Teacher says: Bonjour !
Child voice says (model): Bonjour !
Teacher says: Je m'appelle Nina. Et toi ?
Child voice says (model): Je m'appelle Sacha.
Teacher says: Super !
Child voice says (model): Et toi ?
Teacher says: Je m'appelle Nina !
Child voice says (model): Salut Nina !
Teacher says: Au revoir !
Child voice says (model): Au revoir !
Teacher prompt: Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Nina. Et toi ?
Teacher recap: You can now say hello, and tell someone your name with je m'appelle. And you can ask et toi.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello again! Today you'll learn how to ask a friend how they are, and how to answer. We'll start with a greeting, say our names, and then, the new part: ça va. Listen carefully to how it sounds.
Teacher explains: Ça va means 'how are you?', and also 'I'm fine'. You can say ça va bien for 'I'm good', or ça va mal for 'not so good'. Say them after me.
Teacher says: Salut !
Child voice says (model): Salut !
Teacher says: Je m'appelle Nina. Et toi ?
Child voice says (model): Je m'appelle Sacha.
Teacher says: Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Ça va mal. J'ai perdu mon chapeau !
Child voice says (model): Oh non !
Teacher says: Au revoir !
Child voice says (model): Au revoir !
Teacher prompt: Salut ! Ça va ?
Teacher recap: Now you can greet, say your name, and ask and answer ça va. That's a real conversation!

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today there's a mystery bag. Inside is a surprise, and you'll guess its colour. We'll keep greeting each other and checking how we are, and the new words are colours: rouge, bleu, jaune and vert. Let's find out what's in the bag!
Teacher explains: Colours first. Rouge is red. Bleu is blue. Jaune is yellow. Vert is green. And to ask 'what colour is it?' you say c'est quelle couleur.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Ça va bien. Regarde, un sac mystère !
Child voice says (model): C'est quelle couleur ?
Teacher says: Devine !
Child voice says (model): C'est rouge ?
Teacher says: Non !
Child voice says (model): C'est bleu ?
Teacher says: Oui ! C'est bleu !
Child voice says (model): Super !
Teacher prompt: Je cache un ballon. C'est quelle couleur ?
Teacher recap: You know four colours now: rouge, bleu, jaune, vert. And you can ask c'est quelle couleur.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today you're helping at a very small fruit stand, and you'll need to count. We'll greet each other, talk about colours, and learn one to five: un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq.
Teacher explains: Let's count together. Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq. To ask how many, you say combien.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Regarde mes ballons. Ils sont rouges et bleus.
Child voice says (model): Combien ?
Teacher says: Compte avec moi !
Child voice says (model): Un, deux, trois !
Teacher says: Encore !
Child voice says (model): Quatre, cinq !
Teacher says: Cinq ballons !
Child voice says (model): Super !
Teacher prompt: J'ai des ballons jaunes. Combien ?
Teacher recap: You can count from one to five, and ask combien.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello again! Yesterday you counted to five. Today we're going all the way to ten! Listen to the new numbers: six, sept, huit, neuf, dix. Notice how the 't' in sept sounds.
Teacher explains: Six, sept, huit, neuf, dix. Now the whole row: un to dix. Take a breath and say it with me.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Très bien. Regarde mes cartes !
Child voice says (model): Combien ?
Teacher says: Compte !
Child voice says (model): Six, sept, huit !
Teacher says: Et après ?
Child voice says (model): Neuf, dix !
Teacher says: Dix cartes jaunes !
Child voice says (model): Bravo !
Teacher prompt: J'ai des cartes. Compte jusqu'à dix !
Teacher recap: You count to ten now. Numbers, colours, and how-are-yous are all working together.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we play a game like Simon Says. I tell you to touch a part of your body, and you say it out loud. We'll start with a greeting, then add body parts: la tête, le nez, la bouche, les mains, les pieds. Ready to move?
Teacher explains: Let's name them. La tête is the head. Le nez is the nose. La bouche is the mouth. Les mains are the hands. Les pieds are the feet. Touch each one as you say it.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: On joue ? Touche ton nez !
Child voice says (model): Voilà, mon nez !
Teacher says: Touche ta tête !
Child voice says (model): Voilà, ma tête !
Teacher says: Combien de mains ?
Child voice says (model): Deux mains !
Teacher says: Et combien de pieds ?
Child voice says (model): Deux pieds !
Teacher prompt: Touche ta bouche. Qu'est-ce que tu touches ?
Teacher recap: You can name five body parts, count them, and play the touch game in French.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we visit a farm, and the animals have lost their sounds! You'll name each animal, and then help it find its sound. New words: la vache, le cochon, le canard, le cheval, le mouton. Let's go to the farm!

Teacher explains: Meet the animals. La vache is the cow. Le cochon is the pig. Le canard is the duck. Le cheval is the horse. Le mouton is the sheep. To ask what something is, you say qu'est-ce que c'est.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Très bien. Regarde, qu'est-ce que c'est ?
Child voice says (model): C'est une vache !
Teacher says: Oui ! Elle est noire et blanche.
Child voice says (model): Et ça, qu'est-ce que c'est ?
Teacher says: C'est un cochon rose.
Child voice says (model): Un cochon rose ! Super !
Teacher says: Combien de canards ?
Child voice says (model): Trois canards !
Teacher prompt: Regarde la ferme ! Qu'est-ce que tu vois ?
Teacher recap: You know farm animals, and you can ask qu'est-ce que c'est. You also used colours and numbers in the same conversation.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we talk about pets. Do you have a cat? A dog? You'll learn to say j'ai, which means 'I have', and to describe your pet with a colour. New words: le chat, le chien, le poisson, l'oiseau.
Teacher explains: Le chat is the cat. Le chien is the dog. Le poisson is the fish. L'oiseau is the bird. To say 'I have', say j'ai. To ask 'do you have?', say tu as.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Tu as un animal ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, j'ai un chat !
Teacher says: Il est de quelle couleur ?
Child voice says (model): Il est noir.
Teacher says: Il s'appelle comment ?
Child voice says (model): Il s'appelle Pomme.
Teacher says: J'ai deux poissons rouges !
Child voice says (model): Super !
Teacher prompt: Tu as un animal ? Il est comment ?
Teacher recap: Now you can talk about pets: j'ai un chat, il est noir, il s'appelle Pomme.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we look at a family photo. You'll say who's who: maman, papa, frère, sœur. And you'll use j'ai again, to say how many brothers or sisters you have. Let's open the photo album!
Teacher explains: Maman is mum. Papa is dad. Un frère is a brother. Une sœur is a sister. To introduce someone, you say voici, which means 'here is'.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Regarde la photo. Tu as une famille ?
Child voice says (model): Oui ! Voici ma maman.
Teacher says: Et lui ?
Child voice says (model): Voici mon papa.
Teacher says: Tu as un frère ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, j'ai un frère.
Teacher says: Il a quel âge ?
Child voice says (model): Il a cinq ans.
Teacher prompt: Montre-moi ta famille !
Teacher recap: You can introduce your family now: voici ma maman, voici mon papa.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we're at a fruit stand. You'll ask for fruit politely with je voudrais, which means 'I would like'. New words: la pomme, la banane, l'orange, la fraise. Hungry yet?
Teacher explains: La pomme is the apple. La banane is the banana. L'orange is the orange. La fraise is the strawberry. To ask for something, say je voudrais.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Très bien. Qu'est-ce que tu veux ?
Child voice says (model): Je voudrais une pomme.
Teacher says: Rouge ou verte ?
Child voice says (model): Rouge !
Teacher says: Voilà ! Combien ?
Child voice says (model): Deux pommes.
Teacher says: Et une banane ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, une banane.
Teacher prompt: Bonjour ! Tu voudrais quoi ?
Teacher recap: You can order fruit and say how many: je voudrais deux pommes.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today's challenge: say what you like and what you don't. It's a very useful sentence, because friends love to talk about this. J'aime means 'I like'. Je n'aime pas means 'I don't like'.
Teacher explains: J'aime is 'I like'. Je n'aime pas is 'I don't like'. You can use it with fruits, animals, colours, anything we have learned!
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Tu aimes les fraises ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, j'aime les fraises !
Teacher says: Et les bananes ?
Child voice says (model): Non, je n'aime pas les bananes.
Teacher says: Tu aimes quelle couleur ?
Child voice says (model): J'aime le bleu.
Teacher says: Moi aussi !
Child voice says (model): Super !
Teacher prompt: Tu aimes quoi ? Tu n'aimes pas quoi ?
Teacher recap: J'aime and je n'aime pas let you say what you think. You can use them with everything you know.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we open a school bag. A very sneaky bag, because some things are missing! You'll name school objects: le crayon, le livre, le cahier, le sac. And you'll answer c'est un... or c'est une...
Teacher explains: Le crayon is the pencil. Le livre is the book. Le cahier is the notebook. Le sac is the bag. La règle is the ruler.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Regarde dans mon sac. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
Child voice says (model): C'est un crayon !
Teacher says: De quelle couleur ?
Child voice says (model): Il est jaune.
Teacher says: Et ça ?
Child voice says (model): C'est un livre.
Teacher says: Combien de cahiers ?
Child voice says (model): Trois cahiers.
Teacher prompt: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a dans ton sac ?
Teacher recap: You can name school objects, and describe them with colours and numbers.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today there's a missing cat somewhere in the house. You'll ask where it is, and find out which room it's in. New words: la cuisine, la chambre, le salon, la salle de bains. And a new question: où est, which means 'where is'.
Teacher explains: La cuisine is the kitchen. La chambre is the bedroom. Le salon is the living room. La salle de bains is the bathroom. Où est means 'where is'. Dans means 'in'.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Oh non, je cherche le chat !
Child voice says (model): Où est le chat ?
Teacher says: Je ne sais pas. Dans la cuisine ?
Child voice says (model): Non, il n'est pas dans la cuisine.
Teacher says: Dans la chambre ?
Child voice says (model): Oui ! Il est dans la chambre !
Teacher says: Il est de quelle couleur ?
Child voice says (model): Il est noir.
Teacher prompt: Où est ton chat ?
Teacher recap: You can ask où est and say where something is: il est dans la chambre.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we build a picture out of shapes. A circle, a square, a triangle, a star. You'll describe each shape, and say its colour. New words: le cercle, le carré, le triangle, l'étoile.
Teacher explains: Le cercle is the circle. Le carré is the square. Le triangle is the triangle. L'étoile is the star. In French, the colour comes after the shape: un cercle rouge.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Ça va. On dessine ? Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
Child voice says (model): C'est un cercle !
Teacher says: De quelle couleur ?
Child voice says (model): C'est un cercle bleu.
Teacher says: Et ça ?
Child voice says (model): C'est un triangle jaune.
Teacher says: Combien d'étoiles ?
Child voice says (model): Cinq étoiles !
Teacher prompt: Dessine un carré. De quelle couleur ?
Teacher recap: You can name shapes and give their colours: un cercle rouge, un triangle vert.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we check the weather together, like a real weather reporter. New words: il fait beau, il pleut, il fait chaud, il fait froid. And a new question: quel temps fait-il?
Teacher explains: Il fait beau means it's nice weather. Il pleut means it's raining. Il fait chaud means it's hot. Il fait froid means it's cold. To ask about the weather: quel temps fait-il.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Regarde par la fenêtre. Quel temps fait-il ?
Child voice says (model): Il fait beau !
Teacher says: Il fait chaud ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, il fait chaud.
Teacher says: Tu aimes quand il pleut ?
Child voice says (model): J'aime la pluie.
Teacher says: Moi aussi !
Child voice says (model): Super !
Teacher prompt: Quel temps fait-il aujourd'hui ?
Teacher recap: You can give a weather report: il fait beau, il pleut, il fait froid.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we learn the days of the week, with a little rhythm to help you. Lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche. Don't worry about saying them fast. We'll go slowly, then bit by bit faster.
Teacher explains: Lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche. Clap on every day if you like. And to ask what day it is, you say on est quel jour.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: On est quel jour ?
Child voice says (model): On est lundi.
Teacher says: Et demain ?
Child voice says (model): Demain, c'est mardi.
Teacher says: Tu aimes quel jour ?
Child voice says (model): J'aime le samedi.
Teacher says: Pourquoi ?
Child voice says (model): Il n'y a pas d'école !
Teacher prompt: On est quel jour ? Tu aimes quel jour ?
Teacher recap: You can say the seven days, and answer on est quel jour.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we get dressed, in French! A pullover, a hat, shoes. You'll say what you're wearing, and describe the colour. New words: le pull, le chapeau, les chaussures, le pantalon. And the key verb: je porte, meaning 'I'm wearing'.
Teacher explains: Le pull is the sweater. Le chapeau is the hat. Les chaussures are the shoes. Le pantalon is the trousers. Je porte means 'I am wearing'.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Il fait froid ! Qu'est-ce que tu portes ?
Child voice says (model): Je porte un pull.
Teacher says: De quelle couleur ?
Child voice says (model): Il est vert.
Teacher says: Et sur la tête ?
Child voice says (model): Je porte un chapeau rouge.
Teacher says: J'aime ton chapeau !
Child voice says (model): Moi aussi, j'aime mon chapeau !
Teacher prompt: Qu'est-ce que tu portes aujourd'hui ?
Teacher recap: You can say what you're wearing and its colour: je porte un pull vert.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we talk about feelings. Not just 'good' or 'bad', but real ones: hungry, tired, scared, sad. And the great news: in French, many feelings use j'ai, 'I have'. J'ai faim. J'ai peur. J'ai sommeil.
Teacher explains: J'ai faim means 'I'm hungry'. J'ai peur means 'I'm scared'. J'ai sommeil means 'I'm sleepy'. Je suis triste means 'I'm sad'. Je suis calme means 'I'm calm'.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Non, ça ne va pas. J'ai faim !
Teacher says: Tu veux une pomme ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, je voudrais une pomme.
Teacher says: Voilà ! Ça va mieux ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, ça va bien.
Teacher says: Moi, j'ai sommeil.
Child voice says (model): Oh, tu es fatigué ?
Teacher says: Oui, un peu !
Child voice says (model): Au revoir ! Dors bien !
Teacher prompt: Comment tu te sens ?
Teacher recap: You can say how you feel in several ways. Real French speakers use these every day.
Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we learn the magic words. Please, thank you, you're welcome, sorry. They make everything smoother, in any language. They also make people smile.
Teacher explains: S'il te plaît means please, when you're talking to a friend. Merci means thank you. De rien means you're welcome. Pardon means sorry, or excuse me.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Tu veux un fruit ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, une fraise, s'il te plaît.
Teacher says: Voilà !
Child voice says (model): Merci !
Teacher says: De rien ! Oups, pardon, j'ai cassé ton crayon.
Child voice says (model): Ce n'est pas grave.
Teacher says: Merci ! Au revoir !
Child voice says (model): Au revoir !
Teacher prompt: Je te donne une pomme. Qu'est-ce que tu dis ?
Teacher recap: Please, thank you, you're welcome, sorry. Four little words that open every door.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we're in a toy room. You'll talk about the toys you have, and ask a friend to play. New words: la balle, la poupée, le train, le robot. And an invitation: tu veux jouer?
Teacher explains: La balle is the ball. La poupée is the doll. Le train is the train. Le robot is the robot. To invite someone, say tu veux jouer.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: J'ai un robot bleu. Et toi, tu as un jouet ?
Child voice says (model): J'ai une balle rouge.
Teacher says: Tu veux jouer ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, s'il te plaît !
Teacher says: Un, deux, trois, lance la balle !
Child voice says (model): Voilà !
Teacher says: Merci !
Child voice says (model): De rien !
Teacher prompt: Tu as un jouet préféré ?
Teacher recap: You can talk about toys, and invite a friend to play with tu veux jouer.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today we go outside, to a garden full of life. You'll say what you see: un arbre, une fleur, un oiseau, un papillon. And the useful sentence: je vois, meaning 'I see'.
Teacher explains: Un arbre is a tree. Une fleur is a flower. Un oiseau is a bird. Un papillon is a butterfly. Je vois means 'I see'.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Il fait beau ! Qu'est-ce que tu vois ?
Child voice says (model): Je vois un arbre.
Teacher says: Et dans l'arbre ?
Child voice says (model): Je vois un oiseau bleu !
Teacher says: Et dans les fleurs ?
Child voice says (model): Je vois trois papillons.
Teacher says: Ils sont jolis !
Child voice says (model): Oui, j'aime les papillons.
Teacher prompt: Tu es dans le jardin. Qu'est-ce que tu vois ?
Teacher recap: You can describe a garden: je vois un arbre, je vois un oiseau bleu.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today you'll say how old you are. In French, you don't say 'I am five'. You say 'I have five years': j'ai cinq ans. It sounds strange at first, but you'll get it right away.
Teacher explains: To ask someone's age, say tu as quel âge. To answer, say j'ai, then your number, then ans. Quel âge, j'ai cinq ans.
Teacher says: Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Nina. Et toi ?
Child voice says (model): Je m'appelle Sacha.
Teacher says: Ça va, Sacha ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va bien !
Teacher says: Tu as quel âge ?
Child voice says (model): J'ai cinq ans.
Teacher says: Moi, j'ai six ans.
Child voice says (model): Tu as un frère ?
Teacher says: Oui, il a dix ans.
Child voice says (model): Super !
Teacher prompt: Tu as quel âge ?
Teacher recap: You can say your age with j'ai ... ans, and ask tu as quel âge.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! Today there's a party! It's a friend's birthday and you're invited. You'll greet, wish a happy birthday, give a present, and say how old they are. Happy birthday in French is joyeux anniversaire.
Teacher explains: Joyeux anniversaire means happy birthday. Un gâteau is a cake. Un cadeau is a present. Une bougie is a candle. And voici pour toi means 'here's something for you'.
Teacher says: Salut ! Ça va ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va très bien ! Joyeux anniversaire !
Teacher says: Merci ! J'ai six ans aujourd'hui.
Child voice says (model): Voici un cadeau pour toi.
Teacher says: Oh, un cadeau bleu ! Merci !
Child voice says (model): De rien !
Teacher says: Tu veux du gâteau ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, s'il te plaît.
Teacher says: Voilà !
Child voice says (model): Merci ! J'aime le gâteau.
Teacher prompt: C'est mon anniversaire ! Qu'est-ce que tu dis ?
Teacher recap: You can go to a French birthday party: you know how to greet, give a present, and say thank you.

Teacher video intro, English. Script: Hello! This is the big one, the final lesson. You're going to put on a little show. You'll use everything you've learned: greetings, your name, how you feel, colours, numbers, animals, family, things you like. Take a deep breath. You've got this!
Teacher explains: Here's a reminder of what you already know. Say these in order and you'll have your own French show: bonjour, je m'appelle, ça va, j'ai ... ans, j'aime, au revoir.
Teacher says: Bonjour à tous !
Child voice says (model): Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Sacha.
Teacher says: Ça va, Sacha ?
Child voice says (model): Ça va très bien ! Et toi ?
Teacher says: Tu as quel âge ?
Child voice says (model): J'ai cinq ans.
Teacher says: Tu as un animal ?
Child voice says (model): Oui, j'ai un chat noir. Il s'appelle Pomme.
Teacher says: Tu aimes les fruits ?
Child voice says (model): J'aime les fraises. Je n'aime pas les bananes.
Teacher says: Merci, Sacha ! Au revoir !
Child voice says (model): Merci ! Au revoir !
Teacher prompt: Présente-toi comme dans un spectacle !
Teacher recap: You did it. You finished the whole kids course: in a real conversation, with real French, speaking all along.
